issue_context.title: Make MongoDB backend multithreaded
issue_context.body:
##### Feature idea summary
The `mongoc` library blocks execution of the metric archiving process until all buffered data has been sent and a response has been received from the database. Blocking operations should be run in separate threads to allow Netdata buffering more than one batch of metrics at a time.

##### Expected behavior
Netdata sends metrics to a MongoDB database in a nonblocking way.
comments: We won't proceed with this approach, but with a refactoring of backends.
